programs.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Set Course for the Heart of the Sun"
programs.sub_title: Set Course for the Heart of the Sun
programs.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us on Earth.

programs.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Tickets, Please"
programs.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Alien Worlds"
programs.desc: A virtual scalpel dissects methane lakes and icy crusts to reveal hidden oceans and water-erupting volcanoes on distant moons.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Asteroids"
programs.desc: By stripping the crust and peeling back craters, CGI exposes the hidden minerals and refueling potential locked inside these asteroid worlds.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programs.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programs.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.
